description:
Scale the Flask API service in '/home/ga/scaling-app/' to run exactly 3 replicas behind the Nginx load balancer. 

1. Modify 'docker-compose.yml' to set the flask service to 3 replicas. You must remove the 'container_name' and fixed host port mapping (5000:5000) from the flask service to avoid conflicts.
2. Update 'nginx/default.conf' to properly load-balance requests across the replicas (e.g., using Docker's embedded DNS resolver at 127.0.0.11).
3. Build and start the stack using Docker Compose.
4. Verify that requests to http://localhost:8080 are distributed across different container hostnames.
5. Save the output of at least 10 sequential curl requests to '/home/ga/scaling-app/verification.txt'.
